bands: Fixed four-frequency concatenations per case and across ALL8 only; no partial-subset aggregate, best-frequency selection, thresholded nonlinearity pass or recommendation from a preferred band.
execution_gate: Stage source/protocol and manufactured controls first. No project arrays or new-frequency solves before independent review/freeze/root GO. Explicit execute flag and exact runner/protocol SHA required; source9f and all old artifacts verified before/after; fresh outer output only.
failure_policy: Prepopulate8cases/64frequencyrows/192stages/1152RHS denominator before numeric input loading. Persist each attempted stage and any available receiver prefix; unknown/zero denominators null. Preserve failures/unattempted rows; no tuning, retry or substitution.
multiscale_context: Frequency continuation is prior FWI work. This descriptive local mismatch diagnosis can motivate a later separately owned control; it establishes neither a remedy nor a cycle-skipping cause.
operator: A(m,f)=K-(2pi*f)^2*diag(m)+i*(2pi*f)*diag(d); direct neighbor graph K diagonal4/h² and in-grid axial neighbors-1/h²; exterior unknowns zero.
original_band_DD_scale: max(abs(saved_g_dot_delta),abs(tangent_DD),norm(saved_g)*norm(delta),1e-12); ordinary consistency tolerance, not a verified enclosure

receiver_diagnostics.objectives: .5 sum abs(sampled residual)^2, no extra frequency/dt/h weights

resource_scope: Receiver-only truth/init/Jdelta outputs about0.4MB uncompressed across64 rows, no full state/adjoint field files, BP arrays or large saved fields. Three sets of6 RHS solves per frequency; tangent reuses initial LU, two factorizations/frequency. Attempts/completions/failed unknown work retained.
role: AI post-outcome engineering initial-linearization diagnostic, not student final design or confirmation
scope: ALL8 reused old49x49 initial/truth witnesses; shared SEAM ancestor and no independent-cohort claim. Fixed frequencies/bands and full failures retained. No optimization, method comparison, physical acceptance, certificate transfer or cycle-skipping causal inference.
tangent: A(m_init,f)*delta_u=(2pi*f)^2*diag(m_truth-m_init)*u_init; source forcing and damping fixed independently of m.
